It's pretty insane the amount of growth we've experience just by engaging with our community

You can see the trendline here clearly, the less I engaged with the platform, the less growth I receive.

I think x is a game of engagement, engage with more people, provide real value

we book about 20 sales calls a month on autopilot using grokbot. i just check a few sample leads before each campaign goes out...

one grok bot runs it with arnies. it comes up with the campaign ideas and writes every message

here's the whole setup, step by step 👇
Businesses can run on compute now

whats a good cold email reply rate?

depends whos counting. some reports count out of office auto replies. some only count people who were actually interested

thats why you see anything from 2% to 3.4% called "average"

someone counted 209 gtm engineer job ads. 95% mention ai

the job used to be building lead lists by hand. now its getting ai to build them, and checking its work
